issues.where: panels A, F, and I, lit storm ridges
issues.what: cream and rust crests are crushed, about 15 to 24 levels darker than A, and the warm color goes dull, so shear filaments soften
issues.fix: lift the white point, restore warm highlight saturation, and bring local contrast back on the lit ridges

issues.where: panels A, B, F, and G, shadow troughs
issues.what: troughs and midtones are lifted, about 4 to 8 levels, so the storm reads flatter and milkier than A
issues.fix: drop the shadow floor and midtones back to A's black depth

issues.what: mids and highlights run darker, about 6 to 14 levels, and the wave relief does not hold A's separation
issues.fix: raise the side-lit crests and open the troughs until the relief matches A

issues.what: the blue emission highlights are clamped, tens of levels under A, and the surrounding darks are slightly hazy
issues.fix: restore the lightning peaks and rim specks, then settle the nightside floor to A

issues.where: vortex walls and lit cloud deck
issues.what: the same grade loss at frame scale: peaks above 160 are about 7 levels darker, and midtone ridges wander by about 13 levels, darker in the lower troughs and slightly lifted on the left wall
issues.fix: match A's highlight curve on the eyewall and crests, and even the left wall and lower troughs to A rather than a global lift

issues.what: the lit deck and limb haze sit about 12 levels darker in the highlights
issues.fix: lift the deck highlights and limb haze to A

issues.what: the same stars are several times hotter at the core, about 15 in A versus 60 to 75 in B, and the galactic dust reads slightly warmer
issues.fix: dim the star peaks and cool the galactic core back to A

issues.what: the limb glow is slightly brighter and a touch wider, and the near-limb clouds run slightly cooler
issues.fix: narrow the haze falloff and warm it to A

issues.where: panel A, Great Red Spot and Io
issues.what: filament micro-contrast and Io's lit face do not hold A, and the shadow penumbra is slightly harder
issues.fix: match A's softer film texture on the spot and soften Io's shadow edge to A

issues.where: panels B and D limb, panel I terminator
issues.what: sunlit limb bloom is slightly hot, and the terminator roll-off is slightly darker and narrower
issues.fix: reduce the limb bloom and open the terminator to A
